Class MatrixRequest

Namespace
SharpValhalla.Models.Request
Assembly
SharpValhalla.dll

A request structure for calculating travel time and distance matrices between multiple locations. Use MatrixRequest to compute one-to-many, many-to-one, or many-to-many matrices that provide travel times and distances between locations. Useful for route optimization, delivery planning, location analysis, and travel time calculations.
